name: The Story of Colorless Town
source:
When Alice Cheerington encounter a new town, she feels something off. With the help of her partner in crime, Marco Blueno she try to reveal the secret of Monoch Rome.

This game was made for Tyrano Gamejam 2018.

[From [url=https://raitgame.itch.io/the-story-of-colorless-town]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当爱丽丝·奇林顿遇到一个新城镇时，她感觉有些不对劲。在犯罪同伙马可·布鲁诺的帮助下，她试图揭开莫诺克罗马的秘密。

该游戏是为Tyrano Gamejam 2018制作的。

[来自[url=https://raitgame.itch.io/the-story-of-colorless-town]Itch.io[/url]]
